prompts.obsBasePrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game architectural plate from this approved Observatory reference. Remove ONLY freestanding interactive furniture: entire telescope/mount, left desk/monitors/chair, left armchair/side table, right instrument table/globe/chest, foreground journal table and floor rug. This is a composable architecture overlay, later sky and furniture will be independent layers. Rich handcrafted pixel art, preserve original composition, no redesign. Wide 16:9.
